name: manual_f5a5b4
claim: launchd bootout is asynchronous, so a reload must wait for the port to be released, check bootstrap's return code and retry it, and trust a readiness probe only after the old service has gone. On 2026-11-25 the first live apply ran bootstrap while the old process was still being torn down, the return code was ignored, and a probe that hit the dying service passed, which hid an unloaded gateway until a later status check said stopped. Fixed test-first with a fake launchd that fails bootstrap on the first calls and records ordering; the live gateway was recovered by a manual bootstrap.

decisions.notes: Found by verifying with openclaw gateway status after the apply instead of trusting the module's own success message.

rationale: Found by verifying with openclaw gateway status after the apply instead of trusting the module's own success message.
